answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 3687 Country: NL Title: Is it Sunnah to read after the Jumuah Salat 7 times Surah al Fatiha and also 7 times Surah Ikhlaas, Falaq and Naas? Is here a hadith about? Question: Is it Sunnah to read after the Jumuah Salat 7 times Surah al Fatiha and also 7 times Surah Ikhlaas, Falaq and Naas? Is here a hadith about? Answer ID: 3687 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 464/420=D) There are many traditions of the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) which signify the importance of reciting Surah Fatiha and Muawwazatain ( سورۃ الفلق و سورۃ الناس ) in different times like morning and evening, but we did not find any hadith which specify the number of recitation in 7 and after Jumuah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
